description: Revert to the aggressive Matrix LR (0.11) and the stable Depth 10 / Batch 128 configuration, as the previous run with LR 0.08 (val_bpb=0.9800) likely under-utilized the 5-minute budget by converging too slowly, and historical data suggests 0.11 is the optimal setting for rapid convergence in this short timeframe, aiming to recover the historical best of ~0.983 or better.
